content.text:
I can't give you a Q3 gross margin. Q3 (July 1 to September 30, 2026) has no usable export.

- **September 2026:** There is no snapshot, so the quarter-end close isn't in the exports.
- **August 2026 (the only Q3 data):** The snapshot is blocked. Its quarter-to-date column covers July 1 to August 31, so it is an unfinished quarter. It failed a check because the worksheet for the Service reporting unit is missing. The company totals can't be reconciled with their units, so the export can't be validated. I haven't used it.

The exports also hold only actuals, with no forecast or budget, so I can't project Q3 from them.

The usable snapshots cover Q1 (2026-03) and Q2 (2026-06). I can give you the gross margin for either quarter, or bridge Q1 to Q2, if that helps. For Q3, you'd need a corrected August export (with the Service worksheet) or the September close.
